item.title: EiskaltDC++ 3.0.0-pre.3
item.description:
# EiskaltDC++ 3.0.0-pre.3
Preview of the integrated Direct Connect and BitTorrent client.
## Changes Since pre.2
- Compact native interface refinements, complete toolbar captions, and a separate default Superdesign icon family. Existing icon families remain available. - Consolidated global, Torrent-only and hub-list proxy configuration; reorganized download settings and corrected settings alignment, checkbox and TLS controls. - Explicit per-hub compatibility for legacy short password challenges, disabled by default with a warning. Other hubs retain strict challenge validation. - Visual BBCode composing in hub/private-message inputs, including complete supported typed/pasted markup, formatting actions, history and undo/redo. Unknown or incomplete tags remain literal; previews do not fetch remote content. - Refreshed all 25 Qt/core language catalogs for the current interface. - Refined quit/update admission diagnostics and expanded regression coverage.
## Downloads And Updates
- Intel x86_64 only: macOS 14 or newer. - Apple Silicon arm64 only: macOS 26 or newer.
Both include the native updater. Internal macOS build **30000010** orders this release after pre.2/build30000002. Eiskalt owns update transport and staging; installation is admitted only after an explicitly committed normal quit.
The applications are **ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized**. Sparkle update archives and feeds are separately authenticated with the pinned update key. macOS may require approval before first launch.
## Verification Limits
Both CPU builds passed 2,083 fresh local regression cases each; eight opt-in network tests per CPU were skipped. An unchanged Torrent test binary explicitly reuses its prior 169-case result rather than claiming a new run. Production updater-owner capability probes and isolated bundled Cocoa startup passed on macOS 27; Intel ran under Rosetta. These are not physical Intel or native minimum-OS acceptance tests, nor proof of complete live-network behavior.
The historical intermittent private checked-shutdown refusal remains unresolved. Native NSColorPanel automation, native-speaker translation review and broader Windows/Linux qualification remain limitations. Dependency section/source mapping is not whole-archive reproducibility or legal certification. Exact consumed OpenSSL 3.4.1 headers and provenance are supplied; the full 3.4.1 upstream archive is not locally retained/verified. Runtime OpenSSL mappings remain 3.6.3.
Project and matching dependency sources, component notices and SHA-256 hashes accompany these downloads. Application source: `813ef5b7549f263c2ad5da815013cfa29eb83848`.
